title: Michael M Probable NDE 5225
content: I was hit by a car and thrown sixty meters from point of impact. The police pronounced me dead at the scene. The ambulance crew revived me a couple of times. I died at the hospital, yet I could see and hear everything that was said during the entire time. Even through the coma I could see my children who came to visit, they just couldn't hear me.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Accident. Direct head injury pronounced dead 3 times lay in a coma for 21/2 weeks Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function)
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Darkness | Light | Special Knowledge | Life review | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal Right throughout.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There was no time.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I had no body - yet I could see and feel.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm i seen Jesus .....someone i didnt believe in before the accident
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control God was real.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I knew the name of my grandson two years before he was conceived.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I now have Jesus where before I didn't believe at all.
elements.What is your religion now?: Moderate Jesus just Jesus now ..no denomination
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I now have Jesus where before I didn't believe at all.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Because no one believed me.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Yes, finding out that Jesus was actually real.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I started to tell people as soon as I came out of the coma, no one believed me.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I could move and walk when doctors told me I was not able to.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real Things I saw while in the coma I have checked on the internet and they are actually happening or have happened - my grandson just for one.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I have put what I could see as best I could onto YouTube under 'mixseldik'.
